root_cause_hypothesis: Validation and publication paths were repaired independently without an enforced end-to-end transaction contract.
failure_pattern: snapshot push failures, stale data, partial publication, unverified exchange timestamps
never_forget_rule: Every PR must retain 219 coverage, exchange freshness validation and staged snapshot rollback; CI runs tools/memory_guard.py
limitations: Repository CI guard and tests reduce regression risk but cannot guarantee future availability or correctness.
